title: stage's Participants tab
howToOpen: Open the event, click the stage's tab, then the Participants sub-tab.

reviewed.note: components/audienceList/audienceList.jsx. Two calls: audience_for_product with product_uuids (every vendor that deals in the product, paged by 10 on screen) and the same with show_bidders=true (the vendors on this stage). The invited vendors are the ones checked; their rows sit among all the product's vendors.

groups.title: The stage's Participants tab lists every vendor invited to the stage, with the email the API returns
No screen of the event looks fine while a request behind it failed, and none reports an error while its requests succeeded
